description: The discussions about a brand heating up RIGHT NOW: posts of the last window that mention one of its keywords and whose comments grew by delta in the last hours (or were born loud), each with title, url, author, comments, comments_from/to, delta, hours, rising, alerted_at. The answer to 'where should I comment today': hand the user the biggest deltas with their links and a proposed comment. all=true adds what is most commented even when not climbing (rising false, delta null = one reading), rising first: the app's dashboard list. When it comes back empty read machine in the answer: extension_alive false = no Chrome with the poll on reported in 15 minutes, only Reddit is searched, tell the owner. Never post the comment yourself.

all.description: true = every matching post of the window, rising first then most commented (default: only the rising ones).

hours.description: The span the comments grew in (default 8).

limit.description: With all: how many rows (default 40, up to 100).

networks.description: reddit, quora, x, instagram, tiktok, bluesky (default: all).

window.description: How far back a post may be, in hours (default 24).

name: viralhunt_brand_hot
